sentence: This project tests how psychosocial, forensic, and neuroimaging measures together predict mental health outcomes over time in incarcerated women.
This project provides shared resources and expertise to study molecular mechanisms of aging and the capacity to recover from stress.
This project provides imaging equipment and expertise so researchers can study cancer in small animals and tissue specimens.
This project studies how a virus that infects the fungus Cryptococcus neoformans works and how it changes the fungus's ability to cause disease.
This project studies how senescent neurons harm the tissue around them in the aging human brain, using human brain data and mouse models.
This project tries to find out how an overactive cancer gene and an inactive tumor suppressor work together to cause prostate cancer.
This project tries to find cancer vulnerabilities and to develop and test small molecules and biologics in clinical trials.
This project uses bacteria that home in on tumors and carry membrane-bound therapeutics to deliver cancer treatment safely inside the tumor.
This project uses two high-throughput methods to study how microglia and astrocytes interact during inflammation in the central nervous system.
This project builds a system that freezes donor livers and rewarms them with electromagnetic methods so the livers can be stored longer.
This project uses single-cell mass cytometry and multiplex imaging to study how the human innate immune system affects recovery after surgery.
This project builds statistical and computational methods that use genomic data from tumors to help prevent cancer through risk-based intervention.
This project builds small molecule drugs, an immunotherapy, and a rapid diagnostic tool to fight fungal infections that resist existing treatments.
This project builds artificial intelligence methods to predict how patients respond to T cell therapies from measurements of molecules, cells, and tissues.
This project studies how a chemical change made to proteins after they are built helps silence retrotransposons in the skin.
This project studies how two proteins cause kidney cell death after reduced blood flow during cardiac surgery and looks for peptides that stop it.
This project builds machine learning methods to analyze diffusion MRI scans of fetuses in utero and tests them on congenital heart disease.
This project studies how amplification of Nuclear Coactivator Receptor 3 helps a type of small cell lung cancer grow.
This project tests how well and how safely the pentapeptide treats intestinal injury caused by radiation.
This project builds a tendon-specific microphysiological system to study how losing extracellular matrix stiffness increases inflammatory signaling.
